plans.name: 1. Build from the FCS files, compensate and save the first checkpoint (fresh window)
1b. Compensation check: the spill matrix and the uncompensated-against-compensated panels (in the session that ran plan 1; writes two PNGs, changes no object)
2. Cluster, give every SOM node a level, embed in the UMAP and save the second checkpoint (fresh window)
2b. Figures the merge canvas is authored from: pooled table, heatmap, UMAP by cluster, marker and sample, and stacked bars (after plan 2; reads the saved object and changes nothing)
3. Merge the clusters from the canvas and save (after the canvas is edited; fresh window)
4. Figures of the merged labels: pooled table, heatmap, labelled UMAP, UMAP by sample and stacked bars (after plan 3; reads the saved object and changes nothing)
